preKeyFindings.finding: o1 treats the mechanical housing as an electrical output terminal, an implausible category error. Use a real terminal/connection misconception; only three options makes this especially weak.
Option3 attributes calibrated translational position merely to I2C connection, an implausible communication-versus-estimation category error; replace with a meaningful tilt/calibration misconception.
Option3 claims a color filter array replaces the ADC with purely optical labels, a weak optical-filter-versus-digitizer category error rather than a plausible color-sampling misconception.
Option1 claims connecting a camera eliminates reference evaluation, an implausible hardware-versus-validation shortcut; prefer a concrete inspection/contrast tradeoff.
Option2 assigns calibrated per-pixel depth by definition to object detection, an unrelated output-task category error. Prefer plausible localization/classification alternatives.
Option3 equates class vocabulary with exactly600objects in everyframe and then miscounts inclusiveindices, an implausible compound distractor.
Option3 combines RGB intensity as universal metric depth with a depth map containing only names; two implausible output-category errors rather than a focused depth/coordinate misconception.

Option1 addresses black gaps rather than why color is not physical paint, and option3 simply repeats the misconception negated in the stem. Use parallel color/depth interpretations to avoid stem-given answer.
